can we do something about the elitism in <#1170692781216378960> cuz its gotten to a point where it is actively decreasing my enjoyment of the game and i fear with the new dtide update it will only become worse
You can make relevant reports to the staff or directly with <@575252669443211264>
i get that but its not a problem with just a few users anymore but it feels like thats where the chat in general has been going

Ok, but what could we do for it? 
Staring to tackle the most egregious ones is good to gradually manage it better.
Me all the time what who said that??

Most of the time, the <#1170692781216378960> is filled with people discussing meta & units, and while that’s definitely what it’s meant to be, it also feels exclusionary for any more casual players who aren’t as good in the game (not hitting 400-425) to try and participate
And also even when i did i judt get dismissed and bullied some more cuz “i didnt try hard enough”
Ngl the whole elitism thing has been a huge problem for a while, it’s gotten worse with people putting their dtide scores in their names
It causes an environment that easily helps new players develop upwards, but at the same time, it pushes out anyone who isn’t clearing regularly or is super familiar with the playerbase

What options could be consider?
Maybe making a morimen-casual-talk section?
Im familiar but i just stop posting clears cuz it goes past making a joke to just straight bullying and like ive said its just made me enjoy the game less
Also doesnt help that i am a diagnosed autistic person so its hard for me when it just feels like im getting bullied on a playground for no reason
Ill try and see if i can look at some behavior but overall its just not a great experience for most people

I don’t receive that treatment as much, mostly because I’m a lot more familiar with a lot of those latergame players and the community, but it does feel a little upsetting sometimes when there’s players who ask “Hey what’s your dtide record” as if it’s everything someone needs in order to prove themselves
The venn diagram of those people and those that are elitist is a circle
Btw
Its the same people who do this shit constantly
Ok, but do share some of the more problematic behaviors so we can try to take actions.
Yeah ill try to in the future i guess
I didnt mean to turb this into a whining session but with the new dtide update im just worried

The new Dzone will actually be goated. The "elitists" will have to clear up to the new max else we invalidate their opinions and can't shit talk your comps 

*Uvhash sweeps trust*
